en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a central town square with multi‑storey historic buildings and two tall church/clock towers. The foreground shows an open market square with a few people and a streetlamp. Facades bear German signs for a hotel, restaurants, and cellars. Printed titles in red at the top left read "Rosswein. Markt", and at the bottom center the publisher credit "2424 Brück & Sohn, Meissen." is visible.
